title: Taiwanese American Charity and Education Association 台美慈善教育協會
content_html: The Taiwanese American Charity and Education Association is a nonprofit organization founded in 2007. It supports Taiwanese Americans upon their arrival to the United States, aids their transition to American culture, and helps them maintain strong ties with their homeland. The organization also coordinates aid to residents in Taiwan, including funding for the underprivileged, educational concerns, and disaster relief.
